documents.text: Captain David Pugh House The Captain David Pugh House is a historic 19th-century Federal-style residence on the Cacapon River in the unincorporated community of Hooks Mills in Hampshire County, West Virginia, United States. It is also known by its current farm name, Riversdell. It is a -story frame dwelling built in 1835. It sits on a stone foundation and has a -story addition built in 1910.
